name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2177: His window is 1120 wide because control_app opens it that way, and at 1120 the console laid itself out 1575 wide. The html element reported a scroll width of 1120, identical to the inner width, with overflow-x hidden on both html and body, which means the 455 pixels past the right edge were not scrollable, they were GONE. Off that edge sat the Vault tab and the TV-D tab, entirely, so the vault manager and the tab that runs the chronicle sweep could not be clicked at all. The Tools tab was half clipped. The RELAUNCH NOW button had six of its hundred and forty pixels on screen, and the dismiss X had none, so the bar telling him to relaunch could neither be acted on nor got rid of. That is the literal answer to i cant relaunch. Grok was shown the screenshot cold, with no hint of what it should contain, and independently read the tab strip only as far as Tools and answered no button visible on the bar. The cause is one declaration. The shell is a grid whose first track was a bare 1fr, and a bare 1fr carries an automatic minimum of min-content, so the widest child sets a floor the track can never go below and drags the whole page open. minmax of zero and 1fr removes the floor. Re-measured live at 1120 and 901 and 1440 the page now ends at the window edge, every tab is on screen and hit-tests to itself, and both bar buttons are fully visible while the message ellipsises as its own rule always intended. This file already knew the lesson: v1464 fixed the identical class at 900 pixels and never swept it to the template governing every other width. The Playwright spec is honest that it cannot reproduce this, because under its font metrics the tab strip is 750 pixels against his 1223 and both templates resolve identically, so the stress test I wrote for it was green on the broken tree and I deleted it rather than ship a gate that cannot fail. The deterministic half parses the stylesheet and refuses any bare 1fr page-level track, and it was proven red against the real declaration.
